player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''The Ithorian''') posted a [[Dark]] list on DeckTech in June 2001.
description: This is the Dark Side 30 card space training deck.  It goes hand-in-hand with the other traing decks.
cards: posted: I've Got A Problem Here
notes: Posted 24 June 2001, before Coruscant; no Coruscant-set card, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

This is a 30-card teaching deck by design (not a 60-card tournament deck; the author says to combine it with his first 30-card training deck into a 60-card deck). The list as published totals 29 cards; kept as published.
Starting card as posted: Yavin 4 (the Dark Premiere system); it counts toward the total. No objective or starting interrupt.

Posted 'Tatooine' dested the Dark Premiere system Tatooine (Dark) (Premiere); 'Eraidu' dested Eriadu; 'Imperial Star Destroyer' dested Imperial-Class Star Destroyer; 'R1-G4' dested R1-G4 (Arone-Geefour); 'Deflector Shield Generator' dested the Hoth Device Deflector Shield Generators.
The strategy suggests swapping Captain Needa / Avenger for Praji / Devastator and Eriadu for Coruscant; those swaps are not applied.
